text_block_list.text:
Summoned by Matikanefukukitaru, I arrived 
at the park at night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is terrible, terrible, 
terrible news~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There were so many stars in the sky that a 
whole constellation just plonked right 
down!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: See?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. Hehehe, these are Zodiac 
Chocolates that I crafted through tons of 
trial and error!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Because today is Valentine's Day. As 
someone who loves fortune-telling, I must 
treat festive occasions with the utmost 
importance!
choice_data_list: Are you giving all of this to me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You shouldn't do that~. The blessing 
comes from only eating your own zodiac 
sign, you know."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, which one will it be? What month were 
you born in again, Trainer-san?

"While looking for the chocolate of my 
birth month... I found one that was 
absolutely gigantic. This is..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, well, about that... Wait...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaah, Leo and Scorpio melted and stuck 
togetheeeer~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, half-baked efforts really don't cut 
it, do they? I'm not really used to making 
sweets and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What constellation... well, it has a lion 
and a scorpion, so... ah, it's the 
Manticore constellation, the Manticore 
constellation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Western myths count as gods too! And now, 
a brand new constellation is born!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, give it a taste. It's a flavor 
that would stun even Zeus!

Joking around like that, we ate chocolate 
together. It was a fun and funny 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, which one will it be? What month were 
you born in again, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: You go ahead and eat first, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, starting with me!? Um, well, I'm a 
Gemini.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And Gemini is twice as large! See, it's 
double-sized for Castor and Pollux.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Right. So, um, about that favor...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't we share this? We 
can split it right down the middle.

We shared the chocolate between the two of 
us. A chocolate that tasted far sweeter 
than it actually was...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So good~. As I thought, this is much 
better for me! Way better than being 
nervous giving it to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, it felt totally harmonious and 
sweet, didn't it? We can share our 
thoughts together. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe, thank goodness~ Um, Happy 
Valentine's Day, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on giving you some 
happiness, but somehow I ended up becoming 
happy too.
